title: No Double Invoice
description: A dispatcher's itchy trigger finger shouldn't be able to conjure two invoices for one shipment. The button disables mid-request — but a fast double-click still deserves a real test, not just an assumption it's safe.
successCondition: Rapidly double-clicking "Generate Invoice" on a shipment with no existing invoice results in exactly one invoice existing for that shipment afterward — verified via GET /api/billing/invoices filtered to that shipmentId returning a single record — and the UI ends up showing exactly one invoice row, not a duplicated or flickering one.
hints: The button sets disabled={busy} on click, but the true safety net is server-side idempotency (POST /api/billing/shipments/:id/invoice returns the existing invoice on a repeat call) — this challenge is proving both layers hold up together.
A programmatic double-dispatch of the click event (rather than two separate slow manual clicks) is the more reliable way to catch a race.
